answer: Make paid mining seats scarce and Harberger-taxed. The network holds a fixed 1,000 seats; each holder posts a self-assessed price in a public atlas, pays 1% of it per epoch, and must sell to anyone who pays that price. Like moorings on a jetty, a fleet can't add berths by spawning keys, it has to buy them. Assuming a seat earns 5 POA/epoch and honest holders price it near 300, seizing 200 seats costs ~60,000 POA upfront plus 600/epoch in tax. Underpricing to dodge tax invites buyouts at the nadir. Tax funds grading.
